title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the minimum energy required for the muon to circumnavigate the Earth.

title: Final Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the minimum magnetic field strength required to keep the muon in orbit.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Lorentz factor gamma in the context of relativistic motion.

title: Time-Distance Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student must establish the relationship between the muon's lifetime and the time required for the journey.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Final Answer Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a reasonable approximation for the final answers.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors in calculations, such as sign mistakes or missing factors.

title: Magnetic Field Misunderstanding
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not underestimate the strength of the Earth's magnetic field in relation to the required value.
